overview: A polished frontend-only prototype for an AI-powered Identity & Document Screening Platform, with mock data and a blue/white/purple glassmorphism design.
features: Landing page with hero, features, how-it-works, and CTA
Dashboard with statistics cards and recent documents
Drag-and-drop upload page with fake progress animation
Verification result page with status, confidence, and AI analysis cards
Searchable and filterable reports table with export button
Settings page with theme toggle and notification preferences
